title: OnTopic: AI data center providers seek power and bandwidth promise in CPO
summary: Learn how to scale silicon photonics with integrated SiPh and CPO test strategies. In Lightwave eBook,Teradyne and Quantifi Photonics explores seamless testing from lab validation to high-volume manufacturing.
body_markdown:
[← Back to Blog Index](https://www.teradyne.com/company/blog)


As AI-driven bandwidth demands accelerate, integrating SiPh and CPO test solutions into the manufacturing process is becoming critical to scaling photonics. In this Lightwave e-book, Teradyne and Quantifi Photonics share insights on implementing a test strategy from bench validation to high-volume that enables a seamless path to scale.


[Read the full publication to explore our insights.](https://www.lightwaveonline.com/white-papers/whitepaper/55368092/ontopic-ai-data-center-providers-seek-power-and-bandwidth-promise-in-co-packaged-optics)
